questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in TypeScript?
questions.explanation: In TypeScript, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Why use "with open(...)" instead of open() + close()?
options: It closes the file automatically, even on errors
It is required by all languages
questions.correctAnswer: It closes the file automatically, even on errors
